claims.claim: NewServer takes a ConversationOpener; NewStatelessServer takes a MessageHandler
NewServer opens a conversation per contextID, caches it, reuses it, expires it on a TTL
NewStatelessServer keeps nothing between calls; handler sees contextID and the HTTP request's context
Both modes serve the same protocol: JSON-RPC methods, task lifecycle, SSE streaming, agent card
sdk.A2AOpener(pack, prompt) returns an opener; WithCard, WithPort, WithTaskStore options
Two callers presenting the same contextID share a conversation unless WithTaskOwner scopes tasks
sdk.NewA2AServer and sdk.WithA2A* options wrap NewServer and its options
Tasks live in memory by default; implement a2aserver.TaskStore (sdk.A2ATaskStore) and pass WithTaskStore
Handler() returns http.Handler serving agent card, POST /a2a, /healthz, /readyz
Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json; a card with no interfaces points at /a2a on that host
WithCardProvider option exists
Event kinds EventText, EventMedia, EventClientTool, EventPending, EventDone; Error set fails the turn; EventClientTool moves task to input_required
message/send: text is concatenation of text events; parts one per text run and one per media event
ToolResultHandler lets caller tool results come back; stateless server without it refuses tool-result messages
WithTaskOwner: GetTask, CancelTask, SubscribeToTask answer TaskNotFound for others; ListTasks returns caller's tasks, works without contextId; empty owner refused with 401
Without WithTaskOwner ListTasks requires a contextId
With NewServer another caller naming a contextId is refused, also after cache eviction while tasks remain
Task store must implement OwnedTaskStore (CreateOwned, Owner); in-memory store does; TaskQuerier must filter by TaskQuery.Owner
NewServer panics if WithTaskOwner is given a store that cannot record owners
CancelTask marks canceled in store then stops turn via TaskCanceler; SubscribeToTask via TaskEventBus; both default in-process
WithTaskEventBus, WithTaskCanceler options; TaskCanceler.Listen called once at start-up with a function that is a no-op for tasks not running locally
TaskEvent is version-neutral JSON, each subscriber encodes it for its own protocol version and request id
links /sdk/tutorials/10-a2a-server/ and /sdk/reference/a2a-server/ exist; reference lists all options
